title: A store-in-repair registration refusal can mark an overlapping identical registration failed
outcome: A typed pre-insertion refusal (engram_store_transient 503) never publishes a registration failure for a run whose identical POST is concurrently being registered.
acceptance: When a held-claim read is refused as a store in repair before any registration row exists, the failure-publication step does not add the run to registration_failures, even if an overlapping identical POST inserted the row meanwhile; its diagnostic trace is kept.
A behavioural test interleaves a repair-refused handler with a healthy identical registration and shows the run is never reported as a failed registration.
